instruction: Find the customer service contact page.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United Airlines homepage to their customer service contact page. Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify the URL pattern. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts active tab URL using accessibility tree
Metric correctly performs URL pattern matching using regex search on expected patterns
Expected value "united.com/en/us/help/contact" is semantically correct for United Airlines customer service contact page
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict with url field, metric extracts URL and performs pattern matching
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (find contact page) and evaluator verifies URL pattern
Correct parameter handling: metric directly accesses rules["expected"] as expected when type="rule"
Practically feasible: accessibility tree method is robust, regex provides flexibility for URL variations
No edge case issues: handles redirects, query parameters, and prevents false positives with specific pattern
